comment: Skill registry. mandatory skills are always synced and cannot be deselected. recommend_for keys match icm-scaffold archetypes (content, client, ops, software). Local skills are folders in this repo; external skills add a source: {repo, path, ref} where ref is a FULL COMMIT SHA (never a branch or tag - supply chain rule). Review any external SKILL.md before first registration: installing a skill imports its author's beliefs along with its instructions.

icm-sync.description: Keeps IDENTITY.md and CONTEXT.md routing accurate as the workspace evolves

icm-context-scaffold.description: Generates missing CONTEXT.md files as folders grow

skills-manager.description: Updates skills from the library, adds new ones (local or external) on demand

icm-scaffold.description: The workspace factory itself; only for workspaces that will scaffold other workspaces

qa.description: Quality-gates any artefact against the shipped QA rubric: scored card (Evidence, Voice, Completeness, Actionability), PASS/FAIL, fix-list

review-board.description: Multi-perspective review panel for board- or client-bound deliverables: specialist + commercial + QA lenses, chaired synthesis, fitness verdict, driven revision

diagramming.description: Render-tested diagrams via the right tool (Mermaid, PlantUML, Graphviz, matplotlib, D3, browser-JS) in a draw, review, fix loop

pptx.description: Markdown to PowerPoint: reshapes prose into slide-shaped content, embeds diagrams, converts via pandoc with optional house template

funding-finder.description: Sweeps for grants, loans, reliefs and competitions for the workspace's beneficiary lanes, scores deterministically with the bundled fit engine, maintains a watchlist, files a digest. Generalised from the production funding pipeline

ma-playbook.description: M&A playbook for both sides of a transaction: strategic rationale, due diligence red flags, valuation, negotiation terms, integration. Vendored from alirezarezvani/claude-skills @19392f7 (MIT), ecosystem dependencies removed

board-deck-builder.description: Board and investor deck assembly: 11-section structure, 4-act narrative, bad-news protocol. Assumes US VC reporting; adapt for UK/formal boards. Vendored @19392f7 (MIT)

chief-ai-officer-advisor.description: CAIO decision frameworks: build-vs-buy, AI regulatory risk tiers, API-vs-self-hosted economics, AI hiring sequence, with full reference library. Market facts are snapshots, verify before use. Vendored @19392f7 (MIT)

cto-advisor.description: CTO frameworks: technology strategy, team scaling, ADRs, build-vs-buy scoring, tech debt triage, DORA metrics, with reference library. Thresholds are defaults, not laws. Vendored @19392f7 (MIT)

caio-review.description: AI-plan review lens: six forcing questions (evals, error SLOs, regulatory tier, sourcing, cost trajectory, hiring) with SHIP/SHARPEN/BLOCK verdict. Slots into review-board panels. Vendored @19392f7 (MIT)

cto-review.description: Architecture and scaling review lens: scaling cliff, tech debt, team ramp, build-vs-buy TCO, SLOs, security sign-off. Slots into review-board panels. Vendored @19392f7 (MIT)

ciso-review.description: Security review lens: STRIDE, blast radius, detection, incident readiness, notification windows, supply chain. US regulatory assumptions annotated; UK/EU GDPR governs locally. Slots into review-board panels. Vendored @19392f7 (MIT)

cfo-review.description: Financial review lens: burn, unit economics, dilution, opportunity cost, margin trend, bear case, with GREEN/YELLOW/RED verdict. Venture-SaaS thresholds annotated. Slots into review-board panels. Vendored @19392f7 (MIT)

board-prep.description: Adversarial board-meeting preparation: metric drills, hostile question banks per agenda item, honest narrative, mock-director simulation, checklists. Vendored @19392f7 (MIT)

stress-test.description: Systematically attacks a stated business assumption: counter-evidence, bear/stress/catastrophic downside modelling, sensitivity, validation and hedging actions. Vendored @19392f7 (MIT)

postmortem.description: Blameless post-mortem: precise event definition, proper 5-Whys, root cause vs contributing factors, missed warnings, owned and dated change register. Vendored @19392f7 (MIT)

scenario-war-room.description: Cross-functional what-if modelling of up to three compounding adverse variables: cascade mapping, severity levels, early-warning triggers, hedges. Vendored @19392f7 (MIT)

ai-security.description: AI/ML security assessment: prompt injection, jailbreaks, model inversion, data poisoning, agent tool abuse, mapped to MITRE ATLAS with layered guardrails. Vendored @19392f7 (MIT)

humanizer.description: Rewrites AI-sounding prose against Wikipedia's Signs of AI writing: keeps every claim, invents nothing, matches the writer's voice. Note: our house no-dash rule outranks its sample-following on em dashes
